description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Dediyawala, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530002 (24/0376)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determinations for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership details, extents, encumbrances, and other property-related information, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
